headline: Magnificent 7 Loses $1 Trillion
detail: This headline confirms a massive sell-off in the largest tech names, indicating broad market weakness in the sector you're heavily invested in. For your portfolio, this means significant downside pressure on your tech and chip holdings, especially those on margin.
rec: Given the widespread tech weakness, consider trimming positions like QQQ (-9.46%) and SMH (-29.64%) to reduce exposure and manage risk.

headline: Tech Stocks Log Worst Day Since 2020
detail: This reinforces the severity of the current market downturn for tech and AI-related stocks. Your portfolio, being 90% concentrated in these areas and on margin, is directly exposed to this "carnage." Leveraged ETFs will amplify these losses.
rec: With such a strong negative signal for tech, avoid adding to any existing tech/chip positions. Focus on risk management and respecting your stops.

headline: Cloudflare's Stock Mounts Big Comeback
detail: This is a positive outlier in an otherwise bleak tech landscape, showing strength in a specific cloud name. While you don't hold Cloudflare, your CRWD position (also cloud/cybersecurity) is performing well (+24.16%), suggesting some resilience in parts of the cloud sector.
rec: CRWD is your strongest performer. Watch its price action closely; consider taking some profits to de-risk your portfolio, especially with the broader tech weakness.
